newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissho, PTT, Unocal to study Thai pipeline project.
newsitem.headline: Nissho, PTT, Unocal to study Thai pipeline project.

text.p: Nissho Iwai Corp said on Friday that it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Thai and U.S. oil firms to conduct a feasibility study for a 100 billion yen natural gas pipeline project in Thailand.

Nissho has reached an agreement with Thailand's state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) and Unocal Corp of the United States to carry out the feasibility study for the construction of the pipeline connecting Rayong on the Gulf of Thailand coast to Udon Thani in northeastern Thailand.

Unocal has been operating the Erawan gas field in the Gulf since the late 1970s, and production there is already transported to Bangkok and nearby cities, including Rayong, through existing pipelines, a Nissho Iwai spokesman said.

The three firms intend to set up a joint venture firm by the end of this year if the results of the study, which is expected to start immediately and take several months to conclude, turn out to be promising, the spokesman said.
The potential natural gas demand in the northeastern part of Thailand was estimated at 800 million to one billion cubic feet per day, he said.
The feasibility of laying optic-fibre cables along with the planned pipeline will also be examined in the study, he added.
